performance_issues.description: Push mirror sync is done synchronously in the HTTP request handler, blocking the request thread for each mirror's git push operation
performance_issues.impact: Request can block for minutes if there are multiple push mirrors or slow remotes. Timeout = git.TIMEOUT.MIRROR * N mirrors
performance_issues.code_snippet:
for _, mirror := range pushMirrors {
	ok := mirror_service.SyncPushMirror(ctx, mirror.ID)
performance_issues.recommendation: Queue push mirror syncs asynchronously like pull mirror sync does, rather than blocking the HTTP request

performance_issues.description: Each SyncPushMirror call loads the push mirror by ID again from DB, even though it was already loaded in the list
performance_issues.impact: N additional SELECT queries where N = number of push mirrors
performance_issues.recommendation: Pass the already-loaded PushMirror object directly instead of re-fetching by ID

optimization_recommendations.description: Make push mirror sync asynchronous by queuing each mirror sync
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce request latency from O(N * timeout) to O(1)
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Use AddPushMirrorToQueue for each mirror instead of calling SyncPushMirror directly

performance_issues.description: ToPushMirror calls GetRepository for each push mirror to get repo name, but repo is already available in ctx.Repo.Repository
performance_issues.impact: N additional SELECT queries on repository table (likely cached by XORM session)
performance_issues.recommendation: Set pm.Repo = ctx.Repo.Repository before calling ToPushMirror to avoid redundant lookups

optimization_recommendations.description: Pre-set Repo field on PushMirror objects before conversion
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Set mirror.Repo = ctx.Repo.Repository in the loop before calling convert.ToPushMirror

performance_issues.description: IsMigrateURLAllowed performs DNS lookup (net.LookupIP) without explicit timeout
performance_issues.impact: DNS resolution could hang if DNS server is unresponsive, blocking the request
performance_issues.recommendation: Use a context-aware DNS resolver with timeout

performance_issues.description: Delete does not remove the git remote from the repository, leaving orphaned git config
performance_issues.impact: Git config accumulates stale remote entries over time
performance_issues.code_snippet: err := repo_model.DeletePushMirrors(ctx, repo_model.PushMirrorOptions{RepoID: ctx.Repo.Repository.ID, RemoteName: remoteName})
performance_issues.recommendation: Call RemovePushMirrorRemote to clean up git remote config before deleting DB record

optimization_recommendations.description: Add git remote cleanup on delete
